description: Integrate Triton Proton profiler as a new backend in vLLM, complementing existing torch and cuda profilers

userStories.title: Add Triton as a git submodule
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Triton available as a submodule so I can install the latest Proton profiler with up-to-date features.
acceptanceCriteria: Triton added as git submodule under submodules/triton pointing to https://github.com/triton-lang/triton.git
.gitmodules updated with the submodule entry
Proton is importable after running uv pip install -e submodules/triton
import triton.profiler as proton works in the vLLM environment
Existing vLLM build process is not broken
userStories.notes: Proton source code and documentation are located at submodules/triton/third_party/proton after adding the submodule

userStories.title: Add proton to ProfilerKind config
userStories.description: As a developer, I need 'proton' recognized as a valid profiler kind so the config system can route to the Proton backend.
acceptanceCriteria: ProfilerKind literal in vllm/config/profiler.py includes 'proton'
ProfilerConfig accepts profiler='proton' without validation errors
Existing 'torch' and 'cuda' options continue to work unchanged
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement ProtonProfilerWrapper class
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a ProtonProfilerWrapper class that implements the WorkerProfiler interface so Proton profiling integrates with vLLM's profiler lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: ProtonProfilerWrapper extends WorkerProfiler in vllm/profiler/wrapper.py
_start() initializes a Proton profiling session via proton.start()
_stop() finalizes the Proton session and writes output via proton.finalize()
Output is written in Proton's native .hatchet format to the configured output directory
Multi-rank support: output files include rank suffix consistent with existing profilers
Profiler is instantiated correctly from ProfilerConfig when profiler='proton'
Lazy import of triton.profiler to avoid import errors when not installed
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Refer to Proton source and docs at submodules/triton/third_party/proton for API details

userStories.title: Integrate Proton annotations with existing annotation system
userStories.description: As a user, I want existing annotated regions in vLLM to appear in Proton traces so I get meaningful profiling data without code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: annotate_context_manager() in vllm/profiler/wrapper.py supports Proton's scope/annotation API
When Proton profiler is active, proton.scope() or equivalent is used for region marking
Existing annotation call sites work with Proton without modification
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire ProtonProfilerWrapper into worker and factory
userStories.description: As a user, I want to select Proton profiler via config and have it work end-to-end through the existing start/stop profile API.
acceptanceCriteria: create_worker_profiler() or equivalent factory in vllm/profiler/wrapper.py handles 'proton' kind
Proton profiler can be started/stopped via vllm serve + /start_profile and /stop_profile API endpoints
Proton profiler can be started/stopped via LLM.start_profile() / LLM.stop_profile() in offline mode
Profiling output file is created in the configured directory
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Write tests for Proton profiler integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests to verify the Proton profiler backend works correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit test: ProtonProfilerWrapper correctly implements start/stop lifecycle
Unit test: Proton annotation context manager works
Integration test: end-to-end profiling with profiler='proton' produces output file
Test that ProfilerConfig(profiler='proton') is valid
Tests skip gracefully if Proton is not installed (conditional skip)
All existing profiler tests continue to pass
Tests pass

userStories.title: End-to-end validation with vllm serve
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to validate that Proton profiling works end-to-end with the vllm serve command using openai/gpt-oss-20b model.
acceptanceCriteria: vllm serve openai/gpt-oss-20b --profiler-config '{"profiler": "proton", "torch_profiler_dir": "${VLLM_TORCH_PROFILER_DIR}"}' starts without errors
Triggering /start_profile and /stop_profile endpoints produces .hatchet profiling output
Output file is written to the configured directory
Profiling data contains meaningful Triton kernel information
